method: WGS84 shortest-geodesic leg sums. Endpoints and connecting vertices are declared OSW choices from the named-flow geography, not digitized velocity axes.

source.author: S. G. Philander
source.title: Atlantic Ocean Equatorial Currents
source.read_support: Time-averaged Currents, printed188; Figure1 and caption, printed189. Original Figure1 visually reviewed.
source.source_time_convention: Figure1 depicts July–September conditions. No exact observation year, annual extrema or monthly path series inferred.
source_facts: The NEC is the westward band north of the NECC and receives Canary Current water.
The SEC is the westward band south of the NECC and receives Benguela Current water.
Figure1 supplies basin-scale schematic flow context, not surveyed endpoints or a calibrated current axis.

sensitivity.endpoint_choices: Two declared eastern and two western approach gates per current.
sensitivity.interpretation: Endpoint and drawing sensitivity only; neither a confidence interval nor an annual length range. All cases retained.

currents.scope: Principal Atlantic NEC geographic reference extent from the offshore Canary-feed sector west of northwest Africa to the approach east of the Lesser Antilles.
currents.start_gate_reason: 18W16N selects the offshore northwest-African/Canary-feed sector; it is an editorial handoff, not a source-measured NEC origin.
currents.end_gate_reason: 59W14N stops east of the Lesser Antilles approach; downstream Caribbean and Guyana currents are excluded.

currents.scope: Principal central Atlantic SEC geographic reference extent from its eastern-basin westward-flow sector to the offshore northeast-Brazil approach, using the approximately5S schematic branch.
currents.start_gate_reason: 5E6S selects the westward SEC sector offshore southwest Africa in Figure1; upstream Benguela length is excluded.
currents.end_gate_reason: 34W5S selects the offshore northeast-Brazil handoff. The NBC and Brazil Current are excluded.
not_included: Northern and southern parallel SEC branches
Benguela, North Brazil and Brazil currents

geography_review_status: Pending separate geographic screening; source schematic inspected.
